headline: Chile Stocks Fall 1.5% as Wall Street Slumps
summary: The Chilean stock market fell 1.52% as a Wall Street slump weakened the peso to 978.36 per dollar.
why: Emerging market equities and local currencies often react to broad risk-sentiment shifts and declines in major global indices like Wall Street.

impacts.name: Chilean peso
impacts.why: Broader Wall Street slumps weaken the peso against the dollar.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A broad decline in Wall Street equity markets drove a risk-off sentiment that weakened the Chilean peso and pulled local stock indexes lower.
